//: Plugin renderer entries compile to plain ES modules under dist-plugins/<id>/renderer/, served file-per-file over plugin:// (ADR-0044). They must contain NO bare-specifier runtime imports: type-only imports are erased, and anything the plugin needs from the host comes through api.* (CodeMirror instances via api.editor.cm from stage 2). shared/ is included so the renderers' '../shared/…' imports typecheck — and its ESM emission is load-bearing, not dead weight: the merge in scripts/build-plugins.mjs copies it to dist-electron/plugins/<id>/shared/, from where the renderer loads it at runtime over plugin:// and the plugin main sides require() the same files as ESM.
